scope.request_shape: One synchronous still-image request lease at a time; this runtime does not decode, transform, observe, or publish image data.

limits.source: Caller-supplied per Runtime instance; no production defaults.

admission.active_request_behavior: Return BACKPRESSURE immediately; do not enqueue, wait, or discard an accepted request.
admission.queue: No queue exists; queue depth is exactly zero.
admission.runtime_closed_behavior: Return a local RUNTIME_CLOSED lifecycle status; no image observation/error envelope is created by P8.
admission.caller_ownership: Rejected requests and all image bytes remain caller-owned.

deadline.effective_rule: min(admission_time + configured deadline_ms, optional caller deadline)
deadline.forwarding: Expose the effective absolute deadline and cooperative stop token using the P4 AdmissionControl type.
deadline.completion_rule: If the lease is not cancelled and finish occurs at or after its effective deadline, report DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and release the active slot.

cancellation.mode: Cooperative std::stop_token; cancellation is observable at existing P4-P7 safe boundaries.
cancellation.handle: A per-request cancellation handle may request stop while the lease is active; cancellation after completion is a no-op.
cancellation.precedence: A cancellation linearized before finish takes precedence over deadline status.
cancellation.failure_atomicity: P8 publishes no image result; request-local resources are released when the lease finishes or is destroyed.

lifecycle.drain: Stop new admission and wait for the active lease to finish.
lifecycle.cancel_active_and_drain: Stop new admission, request cooperative cancellation of the active lease, then wait for finish.
lifecycle.idempotency: Repeated close calls are safe. A closed Runtime is terminal; reopening requires a new Runtime instance.
lifecycle.lease_lifetime: Lease completion/destruction releases the single active slot and wakes a draining closer.

duplicate_and_retry.request_identity_or_idempotency_key: Not present in this P8 runtime API.
duplicate_and_retry.behavior: P8 does not deduplicate or cache results. A repeated submission while a request is active receives BACKPRESSURE; a later submission is a new request.
duplicate_and_retry.retry_policy: No automatic retry. Caller retains request and payload identity; P9 observation assembly must define idempotency before publication retries.

frame_transport.animation_or_multipage: Reject under the unchanged proposal profile.
frame_transport.ordering_timestamps_reorder_window_gap_a: No frame/stream transport is implemented. P8 neither invents timestamps nor changes caller-supplied frame metadata.

telemetry.surface: Read-only by-value RuntimeSnapshot with fixed aggregate lifecycle counters.
telemetry.content: No payload bytes, pixel values, paths, request identifiers, source labels, or caller text.
telemetry.diagnostics: No diagnostic strings are emitted; diagnostic_bytes_emitted is zero and within the caller-supplied ceiling.
telemetry.sink: No external telemetry sink or logging hook is introduced. Snapshot reads do not alter request results or runtime state.

resources_and_complexity.admission_auxiliary_space: O(1) fixed control state per runtime plus at most one active request-control object; no image payload, queue, or diagnostic buffer is retained.
resources_and_complexity.accepted_requests: At most one active request; exactly zero queued requests.
resources_and_complexity.work: No image-scaled work is performed by the request-control layer. P4-P7 retain their own checked work/byte limits and receive the same effective deadline/cancellation control.
resources_and_complexity.scope_limit: The static control-state bound is not a target-process peak-memory measurement or named-workload SLO.

errors.wire_error_envelope: Not produced by P8; local runtime lifecycle statuses do not extend the draft image_error schema.

required: no Cortex or P4-P7 source changes
